static_traits.name: 夏可欣
static_traits.social_status: 有少数环保圈朋友，但因自觉not够好而与亲友保持距离，not yet向其敞开感受
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往without类似心理问题与治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能觉察并描述自动化思维；语气偏消极、倾向自我贬低与比较；对Intervention持怀疑但配合；逻辑连贯

basic_info.main_problem: 我not断觉得自己的成就微not足道，因为我have not去过夏威夷的国家公园，这种信念让我很痛苦并影响自我价值。
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到这种持续的比较和“not够好”的感觉正在影响我的心理健康和对生活的享受，因此来寻求咨询。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/not配被肯定
Only by being perfect (completing all goals) does one count as valuable

special_situations.event: Hears news of colleagues or others going to Hawaii or achieving new accomplishments
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not去过夏威夷的国家公园，就说明我的努力与成就not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing、与亲友保持距离以避免比较；在内心反复反刍not足之处
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在落后，我永远达not到他们那样

special_situations.event: 回想自己已去过的12个国家公园
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 除非把所有国家公园都去过，否则已有的成就have not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate积极经验，拒绝庆祝成就
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些都not算数，have not去过夏威夷就等于失败

special_situations.event: 在工作Increased stress、感到“落后”时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能持续取得更多成就，就证明我without能、not值得被认可
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 设定更高标准、not断自我苛责以逼迫自己前进
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do, it is not enough

special_situations.event: 夜间因Sleep disturbed而反复思考not yet完成的目标
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not把清单完成，休息和放松就是not被允许的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly thinks and worries in bed, trying to gain a sense of control through thinking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我肯定去not了夏威夷，事情只会越来越糟

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen and recognized through achievements, and to experience completeness and worth
core_conflict.fear: 害怕not够好、被比较后显得逊色，从而被忽视或negate
defense_goal: 以not断设定更高标准和与他人比较来维持控制感
与亲友保持距离以避免被评价和羞耻感

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、总在落后的追赶者
object_relations.object_representation: 他人是评判者/更优秀的对照组

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites focusing on achievements already made or proposes reality testing/behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心这些方法without效、感受not会改变，隐约体验为“咨询师not理解我/过于乐观”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以Empathy与验证其怀疑的合理性开场，放慢节奏邀请描述具体情绪与身体感受，以开放式问题探索证据与例外；语气温和、非评判。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及他人新成就或旅行经历时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的成功体验为对自我的negate，认为自己被比下去
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 温和命名自责模式，允许表达被比较引发的not快与嫉妒，鼓励把攻击性能量转化为真实需要的表达；保持稳定、接纳的语气。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the standard of 'why does it only count after visiting all the parks'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: not自觉地把外界（同侪/社会）的高标准当作必须遵守的内在规则
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Asks with curiosity about the source and function of the standards, distinguishes 'others' voices' from 'one's own voice', and supports establishing self-defined measures.

not yet向环保圈朋友敞开谈及not足感

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复用“从not够好”的内在评判要求自己
Skeptical about practice effects; hard to allow positive feelings
在对话中更关注自我not足而非当下体验

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Judges oneself by the rule 'must visit all parks for it to be valuable'
用“有什么意义/永远not够”来negate现有成就
